_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'value' properties for each field in this ASSUMPTION LOG template based on the provided project context.

ID.guidance: Unique identifier for the assumption or constraint.

Category.guidance: The category of the assumption or constraint (e.g., Technical, Financial, Schedule).

Assumption/constraint.guidance: A clear, detailed description of the assumption or constraint.

Responsible party.guidance: The person who is tasked with following up on the assumption to validate if it is true or not.

Due date.guidance: The date by which the assumption needs to be validated.

Actions.guidance: Specific actions that need to be taken to validate the assumption.

Status.guidance: The current status of the assumption (e.g., active, transferred, or closed).

Comments.guidance: Any additional information, context, or updates regarding the assumption or constraint.
